in_hebrew.name: רולנד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Rowland is derived from the Old English words 'hrode' meaning 'fame, renown' and 'halh' meaning 'rock, hollow'. In Hebrew, this name can be transliterated as 'רולנד' (Rōlnd), and its meaning is 'little red one'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it can be derived from the name Roland, which appears in the Old Testament as 'Rolandos', a variant of 'Roland', meaning 'famous land'.
